tools.name: read_profile
tools.description: Read the user's recorded taste profile. Call this before producing styleful work (writing, music picks, web design, interior design) so the output reflects their calibrated preferences rather than a generic default. Returns each axis with its current position, whether it was set by hand or learned, and its confidence. Also returns the axis ids that update_profile accepts.

dimensions.description: Dimensions relevant to the task. Read the smallest useful set; a landing page is usually web-design plus writing. Omit to read all four.

tools.name: update_profile
tools.description: Record a durable, generalized taste reaction in the structured Taste profile. Use only when the user's feedback is a standing preference that should apply again later. Do not use for one-off constraints, explicit instructions limited to this task, or contentless praise.

dimension_id.description: Taste dimension the reaction belongs to.

axis_id.description: Seeded axis within the dimension. writing: hedging (flat assertion vs hedged), order (conclusion first vs reasoning first), ornament (literal vs figurative), length (short declaratives vs longer clauses), jargon (unglossed vs glossed). music: texture, palette, motion, demand. web-design: web-density, web-hierarchy, web-type, web-navigation, web-colour, web-motion, web-imagery, web-surface, web-finish. interior-design: interior-plan, interior-light, interior-palette, interior-material, interior-furniture, interior-object, interior-age, interior-comfort, interior-contrast. Call read_profile for each axis's left and right labels.

direction.description: Which side of the axis the durable preference favors. read_profile names the left and right label for every axis.

strength.description: nudge for a modest signal, clear for an unambiguous repeated or strongly stated preference.

reason.description: Short generalized reason, phrased as the preference rather than a transcript of the event.
